findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Current public prices and free allowances; no charge." → after: "Current public prices, free allowances and payment discovery; does not create a charge."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "billing" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
